namespace IndexLeTheta187
universe u v w
variable {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {γ : Type w} [ConditionallyCompleteLattice γ]
variable {f : α → β → γ} {s : Set α} {t : Set β} {a : α} {b : β}
theorem generic (hs : BddAbove (Set.image2 f s t)) (ha : a ∈ s) (hb : b ∈ t) :
    f a b ≤ sSup (Set.image2 f s t) :=
  le_csSup hs (Set.mem_image2_of_mem ha hb)
theorem member (s : Set γ) (x : γ) (hs : BddAbove s) (hx : x ∈ s) : x ≤ sSup s :=
  le_csSup hs hx
#print axioms generic
#print axioms member
#check @le_csSup
#check @Set.mem_image2_of_mem
end IndexLeTheta187
